title: Injected work context shows one status per item and tells a resuming agent to read a clipped status before acting
outcome: Injected work context shows one status per item and tells a resuming agent to read a clipped status before acting
acceptance: A work item's status body and latest note head appear at most once in one next response; an item that is both held by and assigned to the caller renders once, and any further discovery row for it (assigned, participated, changed) carries a reference, not a second body or note head

Regression: a status over the preview bound whose STOP condition sits in its tail renders in next with the omission, the locator and the read-first guidance, and the response carries the status bytes once, for the held-and-assigned case and the unclaimed-assigned case

When a status is clipped, the row keeps the explicit omission and detail locator and the response's guidance says to read the full status before acting on any approval or STOP condition; nothing about permissions is inferred from a clipped prefix
